content: Kyakin, bi ikyer alab ubwaŋàbwaŋ ndaa kàwem bi, ntɔn bi ikɔ̈ɔ̈n adiimà mbwo.
Ntɔn, isàkal naa ndaa bàkyään akyeey yàmɛnà naa yà ndandaa, isàkal naa mbɛɛy yanswà anà unkwɛɛm banswà bàkyer awal ntaaŋàmbar aŋàkwo,
apan, bi ŋakwo iyàsɔrà aben, isàkal naa bi kan'bi mɔ̈ɔ̈ a tub àwà, mɔ̈ɔ̈ kàsɛmà Mwol ŋakwo mukyään, anà baar bàwem wa biswɛŋ ntal awa.
Nzam kàmɛy naa imbäl aba kyàkäl kyà ndandaa u mbwo a idiim, impà, ndaa ubem yà ifà ifà, anà unsà an'kab a Dweelà In'kyɛɛl màŋàkab asànaa kàkwen nde ŋakwo.
Ndaa yanswà Nzam kàpɛ akà Mwan
Nzam kàsi anki mɛɛn amà iyà, amà itɛɛnà bi, ungyɛl a in'kɔl a akyeey.
Kyakin kà ikal mwɛy, mbuur mwɛy kàtɛ imbäl abà:

content.text: « Mbuur wà nà ntɔn ngye un'si mii?
Itàkal naa mwan a mbuur ntɔn ngye akun'ler?
Utaaŋ ikikye, ngye kun'tyeey ungyɛl a akyeey,

ngye kàsi indiir byanswà ungyɛl a in'kɔl ande. » Mukun'sà indiir byanswà ungyɛl a in'kɔl, nde kàwɛy anki akà undiir mwɛy ukɔ̈ɔ̈n akal ungyɛl a ikɔb ande. Kyekà, apanà bi ŋàtàman anki naa bya byanswà byàŋàsà ungyɛl a ikɔ̈b ande.

Wɛɛ bi kan'man abà: ungö akun'tyeey ikikye ungyɛl a akyeey, apanà, Yɛsu bàmun'bwää làkoo anà ibyääl, ntɔn ukwà abà kàmɛn nde mpay. Abun, u mbwo a kab a ngway a Nzam, nde kàkü ntɔn baar banswà.

Yàkäl ubwaŋ akà Nzam awà ntɔn nde anà u mbwo a nde abyà indiir byanswà, kàkwen musyen un'kàbɔ a baan u làkoo ande. Kyakin, yàbwɛŋ naa nde usyen Yɛsu, un'bään a mɔ̈ɔ̈ aba, ukäl wàŋàkwo, u mbwo a mpay.
Ntɔn, mbuur afàpöŋ anà bàŋàpöŋ, ba banswà bàfü ntsü mwɛy. Kyakin nde nswɛn yatɛy mukabel atɔŋ ande,
« Mɛ in'yàkyään làsaŋ a ikɔb angye akà atɔŋ amɛ,
mɛ in'kyer ayasyäŋà uboo a nköŋ. »
« Mɛ in'yàsà mpem amɛ amu nde. »
« Le mɛ, mɛ anà baan kan'pɛ Nzam. »

content: Ntɔn baan abà bye anà undiir mwɛy wà un'tüüb, an'kil anà in'twaŋ, ifà imwɛy sye, Yɛsu kàbulà asànaa ba, nde kàbwäär ndür a imbuur. Abun, u mbwo a nkweel ande, nde kàkwaam ngwal a mbuur kàkäärà ukwà, iswaŋà naa Ileŋ.
U mbwo a ba, nde kàtsuuŋ baar banswà bàkäl uboo a isɔ u mɔ̈ɔ̈ aba wanswà ntɔn bɔɔmà a ukwà.
Ntɔn, nde kàyi anki mubay akyeey, wɛɛ nde kayi mubay ywar a Abàlam.
Kyakin, yàlɔ̈m naa nde ubulà asànaa atɔŋ ande unsà indiir byanswà, ntɔn mubulà undweer a angaŋ bàŋàyɔl a ngyɛb anà wàbalàbal unsà isal ande kusà a Nzam, ntɔn mudwa man'be a un'sɛŋ ande.
Apanà, nde kan'kwo mubay baar abàŋàsii, ntɔn nde ŋakwo bàkyer un'sii unsà mpay kàmɛn nde.
